kv18.1:1.4: nanu atthi buddhavutthāni cetiyāni ārāmavihāragāmanigamanagarāni raṭṭhāni janapadānī’ti.
kv18.1:1.6: hañci atthi buddhavutthāni cetiyāni āramavihāragāmanigamanagarāni raṭṭhāni janapadāni, tena vata re vattabbe
kv18.1:2.4: nanu bhagavā lumbiniyā jāto, bodhiyā mūle abhisambuddho, bārāṇasiyaṃ bhagavatā dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ, cāpāle cetiye āyusaṅkhāro ossaṭṭho, kusinārāyaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto’ti.
kv18.1:2.6: hañci bhagavā lumbiniyā jāto …pe… kusinārāyaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto. tena vata re vattabbe
kv18.1:3.5: “ekamidāhaṃ bhikkhave samayaṃ ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi subhagavane sālarājamūle”ti
kv18.1:3.6: “ekamidāhaṃ bhikkhave samayaṃ uruvelāyaṃ viharāmi ajapāle nigrodhe paṭhamābhisambuddho”ti.
kv18.1:3.7: “ekamidāhaṃ bhikkhave samayaṃ rājagahe viharāmi veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe”ti.
kv18.1:3.8: “ekamidāhaṃ bhikkhave samayaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ viharāmi jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme”ti.
